text: Fixed. .fmri_lm_build_config errors when cfg is combined with any other configuration argument, naming the offenders, and returns cfg unchanged otherwise. Removed the dead self-assignment 'merge' - cfg$robust <- engine_cfg$robust and modifyList(cfg$ar, engine_cfg$ar) were no-ops because cfg WAS engine_cfg. Verified end to end: cor_struct='ar2' + cfg=control(iid) now errors instead of silently running iid.
